mutations.name: KB-60 the all-columns public read policy on accounts is back
mutations.sql: create policy "Allow public read of public accounts" on public.accounts for select to anon, authenticated using ((public_profile->>'is_public')::boolean = true);

mutations.name: KB-60 the company page reads accounts again (members only now, so a stranger gets a 404)
mutations.grep: company, project and episode pages render

mutations.name: KB-60 the view exposes the email
mutations.sql: create or replace view public.public_accounts with (security_barrier = true) as select id, name, slug, picture_url, public_profile, updated_at, email from public.accounts where not is_personal_account and coalesce((public_profile->>'is_public')::boolean, false);

mutations.name: KB-60 the view includes public personal accounts
mutations.sql: create or replace view public.public_accounts with (security_barrier = true) as select id, name, slug, picture_url, public_profile, updated_at from public.accounts where coalesce((public_profile->>'is_public')::boolean, false);

mutations.name: KB-60 the view is writable by authenticated
mutations.sql: grant update, delete on public.public_accounts to authenticated;

mutations.name: KB-59 a public table ships without RLS (readonly_viewer reads it by default privileges)
KB-59 a SELECT policy TO public with a constant predicate
mutations.sql: create policy kb59_probe on public.social_posts for select using (true);

mutations.name: KB-59 a definer function becomes executable by PUBLIC
mutations.sql: grant execute on function public.purge_connection_vendor_rows(uuid) to public;
